source: SVO Koester koester2 DA LTE, 4 pi H_lambda, air wavelengths
cooling: Bedard et al. 2020 C/O core; default q_H=1e-4, optional thin q_H=1e-10; q_He=1e-2
units: 10-pc F_lambda for R=1 Rsun, 1e-18 W m^-2 nm^-1
calibration: Absolute single-DA scale: robust log-Teff spline plus linear logg, spectral labels and Gaia parallax
uv_calibration: 71 real single DAs, absolute FUV/NUV passband factors at spectral labels, cooling radius, Gaia parallax and native extinction
model_error: Temperature-dependent correlated absolute scale plus diagonal spectral shape
